Since 2022, Palaeoverse, and its activities, have received support from a number of organisations.


::: {.timeline .vertical-alt style="--tl-gap: 5rem;"}
::: {.event data-label="Feb. 2026"}
Start of funding from the [Software Sustainability Institute](https://www.software.ac.uk/)’s Research Software Maintenance Fund (AH/Z000114/1). This funding lasts until Feb. 2028.

::: {.tl-logo}
![](../../_img/ssi_logos/RED LOGOS/SSI_PRIMARY-LOGO.png)
:::
:::
::: {.event data-label="2024"}
Scientific Exchange grant from the [Swiss National Science Fund](https://www.snf.ch/en) to support the development of the rmacrostrat R package.

::: {.tl-logo .tl-logo-snf}
![](../../_img/snf_logos/png/SNF_logo_standard_web_color_pos_e.png)
:::
:::
::: {.event .tl-flip data-label="Sep. 2023"}
Support for the “R for Palaeobiologists: Workshop and Hackathon” at University College London:

* Meeting support grant from [The Palaeontological Society](https://www.paleosoc.org);
* [The Palaeontological Association](https://www.palass.org/), [Transmitting Science](https://www.transmittingscience.com/), [PRStatistics](https://www.prstatistics.com/), and [Jumping Rivers](https://www.jumpingrivers.com/) sponsored prizes;
* Grant-in-Aid (PA-GA202203, awarded in 2022) from [The Palaeontological Association](https://palass.org).
